integrity_notes: The polynomial and limit are proved analytically; finite enumeration is used only as a consistency check.
The general graph-state color-assignment theorem is prior work; the claimed contribution is the explicit complete-bipartite evaluation and its fixed-side asymptotic law.
scientific_limitations: The formula assumes prime local dimension and the ordinary unweighted adjacency matrix over the finite field.
The two-scale limit holds for fixed m as n tends to infinity; proportional growth of both part sizes is not covered.
The SLD weight distribution is not itself an entanglement certificate or a noise threshold.
title: Exact SLD and two-scale limit for complete bipartite qudit graph states
